topics.topic: Whether and how M30–M34 release tables are delivered to and consumed by the running service
questions: Do M22–M34 and their table rows reach the running service as provider-delivered release constants read by generated code, or are the provider's tables only build-time inputs whose behavior is compiled into the service?

Do the M30–M34 tables reach generated Registry code as provider-supplied release data, and, if so, which product actions read each table; or are they used only outside the running service to derive code or specification data?
For each of M30–M34, who authors and mints the row values, from which exact provider artifact, and when are runtime row values constructed or delivered?

quotes:
The typed constants of the data closure, the one home of each value the
generated code reads that is neither a setting of the environment
(`runtime_settings`) nor a member of an enumeration or a field's type
(`models`) (SPEC_STANDARD
§6.10, §15.3.1; reopened 2026-11-11, replacing the former
release_declarations module)

The list names groups; the data closure names each constant,
and every one is exported.

`module:data_provider` has no operation: it exports constants, and a module
that names one imports it (SPEC_STANDARD §6.10, §15.3.1). The authority for
these imports is the specification's `imports.module_internal`, as for every
internal import (SPEC_STANDARD §7): State 6 writes each row below as the
entry `module_internal[<consumer>]["data_provider"]`, the listed symbols and
no other. This table is the design those entries are written from, not a
second authority beside them. The values are the data closure's.

| `given_values` | `REQUEST_ID_MAX_CHARACTERS`, `ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS`, `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS`, `OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE`, `OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN`, `REQUEST_ID_UNPRINTABLE_CATEGORIES`, `LISTEN_PORT_MIN`, `LISTEN_PORT_MAX`, `FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS` |
| `store` | `STORE_VERSION`, `STORE_TEMPORARY_SUFFIX`, `STORE_COMPANION_STEP_SUFFIXES` |

| `projects` | `REFUSAL_STAGE_EXISTENCE`, `REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES`, `REFUSAL_STAGE_VERSION`, `REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE`, `REVISION_FIRST`, `PROJECT_VALUE_FAILURE_KINDS`, `CUSTOMER_ELIGIBILITY_REFUSALS` |

| `migration_import` | `ARTIFACT_TYPE_OWNERS`, `IMPORT_FILE_MAX_BYTES`, `REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES`, `REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE`, `TEXT_ENCODING`, `DIGEST_ALGORITHM`, `POINTER_VERSION_FIRST`, `IMPORT_FORM_FIELD_MAPPING_FIELDS`, `IMPORT_CHOICE_FAILURE_KINDS` |

| `owner_interface` | `OWNER_ACTIONS`, `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`, `OWNER_FORM_POSITION_MARK`, `OWNER_FORM_PATH_SEPARATOR`, `OWNER_TARGET_PARAMETER`, `OWNER_CSRF_FIELD`, `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME`, `OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES`, `SERVICE_ANSWER_STATUS`, `REFUSAL_HTTP_STATUSES`, `CONTENT_TYPE_HEADER`, `CONTENT_LENGTH_HEADER`, `OWNER_COOKIE_HEADER`, `OWNER_SET_COOKIE_HEADER`, `OWNER_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY_HEADER`, `OWNER_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY`, `OWNER_FORM_MEDIA_TYPE`, `TEXT_ENCODING`, `PROJECT_STATUS_CONFIRMATIONS`, `OWNER_NAVIGATION_ACTIONS` |

check_value_forms: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer one RefusalFailure, carrying the value's path, for every form value outside its form and none for the others, in the order of form_values, each value's form chosen by its field of = models.FormField and each failure's kind the kind of the row of the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant whose field is that field: a value of the ALIAS member of = models.FormField longer than the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant counted in Unicode code points, one of the FLOOR_AREA member of = models.FormField for which _read_decimal_text answers None or whose Decimal is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, one of the ROOMS_COUNT member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None or whose integer is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, one of the FLOOR member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None, one of the OBJECT_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.ObjectKind, one of the CUSTOMER_LANGUAGE member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerLanguage or one of the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerKind.

_build_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST pass every given alias as the ALIAS member of = models.FormField and every given Customer kind as the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField through check_value_forms, each with a path naming its subject, and MUST make one MappingFormFailure for each failure it answers, with the subject of the value, as its field the mapping_field of the row of the imported IMPORT_FORM_FIELD_MAPPING_FIELDS constant whose form_field is the member of = models.FormField the value was passed as, and the kind check_value_forms answered.

create_project: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer a Refusal with the REFUSED member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_LIFECYCLE constant names, changing nothing, carrying a failure of the CONFLICT member of = models.RefusalKind with its path naming the request_id input when a project carries the request id and facts_equal_for_repeat answers false, and after it one failure, its path naming the customer_ref field, when the eligibility answer is a member of = models.CustomerEligibility other than the ELIGIBLE member of = models.CustomerEligibility, of the kind of the row of the imported CUSTOMER_ELIGIBILITY_REFUSALS constant whose eligibility is that answer.

discard_new_store: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST act only on a store open_store made new in this process, answering removed false and touching nothing otherwise; it MUST close the store's connection, then, for each row of the imported STORE_COMPANION_STEP_SUFFIXES constant, in the order = models.DiscardStep declares the rows' steps, remove the companion file whose path is the store's path followed by that row's suffix, that row's step being the step a failure of the removal names, and last the store's file, reading each path's type without following a link, removing only a regular file, passing over a path that does not exist, and stopping at the first step that fails.

_render_owner_page: [BEHAVIOR] MUST give the page of each answer below these links and forms of = models.OwnerAction members, beside those of every page: for a ProjectListAnswer a form of the CREATE_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction and a link of the READ_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction for each item; for a ProjectCardAnswer whose card is a ProjectCard a form of the CORRECT_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction, a form of the ADD_ROOM member of = models.OwnerAction and a link of the LIST_POINTERS member of = models.OwnerAction for its project, and a form of the SHOW_CONFIRMATION member of = models.OwnerAction whose confirm_action is the confirm_action of the row of the imported PROJECT_STATUS_CONFIRMATIONS constant whose status is the project's status, with a choice among the members of = models.ProjectErasure when that action is the ERASE_PROJECT member of = models.ConfirmedAction; for a ProjectCardAnswer whose card is an AnonymisedProject a link of the LIST_POINTERS member of = models.OwnerAction for its project; for a PointersAnswer a form of the PUBLISH_POINTER member of = models.OwnerAction for the request's target and a form of the WITHDRAW_POINTER member of = models.OwnerAction for each pointer of the PUBLISHED member of = models.PointerStatus; for a CustomerListAnswer a form of the RECORD_CUSTOMER member of = models.OwnerAction and a link of the READ_CUSTOMER member of = models.OwnerAction for each item; for a CustomerAnswer whose customer is a CustomerDetail a form of the CORRECT_CUSTOMER member of = models.OwnerAction, a form of the MARK_CUSTOMER member of = models.OwnerAction for each member of = models.CustomerTransition and a form of the ERASE_CUSTOMER member of = models.OwnerAction; for a SessionListAnswer a link of the READ_SESSION member of = models.OwnerAction for each item; for a SessionAccessAnswer a form of the ANSWER_ACCESS_REQUEST member of = models.OwnerAction offering a decline and a grant when its access has a request pending, a form of the GRANT_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction, a form of the SET_ACTIVE_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction and a form of the REVOKE_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction for each granted project, a form of the SET_ACTIVE_PROJECT member of = models.OwnerAction that clears the active project, and a form of the END_SESSION member of = models.OwnerAction; for an AuditViewAnswer a form of the SHOW_CONFIRMATION member of = models.OwnerAction whose confirm_action is the ERASE_AUDIT_ENTRIES member of = models.ConfirmedAction; for an ImportUploadAnswer a form of the SHOW_IMPORT_MAPPING member of = models.OwnerAction offering a pick of each of its projects; for an ImportMappingAnswer a form of the SHOW_IMPORT_MAPPING member of = models.OwnerAction holding the import_choices of the request's values to be changed and, when its mapping is clean, a form of the SHOW_CONFIRMATION member of = models.OwnerAction whose confirm_action is the CONFIRM_IMPORT member of = models.ConfirmedAction carrying those choices; and for a ConfirmationStepAnswer one form of the member of = models.OwnerAction whose value is its action's, for its target, stating its shown_version, carrying its confirmation_value and its inputs.
judgement.why: The later module, import, and behavior texts make these provider-owned data-closure tables exported runtime constants, identify their generated-code consumers, and require the affected operations to read their rows.

The store's one connection — `open_store` opens no other — is closed; then,
in this order, the companion files SQLite may keep beside the store under
its name with a suffix, `-wal`, `-shm`, `-journal`, each removed when it is
a regular file, and last the store's file.

discard_new_store: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST act only on a store open_store made new in this process, answering removed false and touching nothing otherwise; it MUST close the store's connection, then, for each row of the imported STORE_COMPANION_STEP_SUFFIXES constant, in the order = models.DiscardStep declares the rows' steps, remove the companion file whose path is the store's path followed by that row's suffix, that row's step being the step a failure of the removal names, and last the store's file, reading each path's type without following a link, removing only a regular file, passing over a path that does not exist, and stopping at the first step that fails.
judgement.why: The later foundation and behavior texts require the three companion steps in order with suffixes `-wal`, `-shm`, and `-journal`, each supplied by a row of the imported constant.
